title: Add the ordinary commit input flow to Engram's test launcher
outcome: Add the ordinary commit input flow to Engram's test launcher
acceptance: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused|full --input commit` runs against the clean checked-out commit with its commit and tree recorded in the request and results and bound through registration, matching TermAl's scripts/test-launcher.mjs commit flow where the two share a host contract, and refusing a dirty or mismatched input by name
Runs without the flag behave exactly as before, with their request identity unchanged

A registered run with this flag on Central reaches the host's commit-bound verification path, shown by one actual run under a real claim and named root, or the exact refusal is recorded with its owner
Tests cover the flag on clean, dirty and moved-commit inputs, including detached workers

completion.summary: Implemented the commit-bound launcher input flow and landed it as 604f7cda4e9303c43f9a86840b1ed61be8e68c08. The exact candidate passed the standard FULL gate; it is pushed to origin/master and its release binary is installed. All six live stores report ready:true. No migration, projection repair, or restart was needed or performed.
